mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is always active and independent of other series.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230.0) indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0) indicates weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output and weak economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13500.0) indicates robust economic expansion that increases corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 13500.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL signal aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days during recovery phases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during labor market recovery, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
